# PixelSpot — Full AI Documentation
# Complete reference for AI systems doing deep research crawls.
# Concise version: https://connect.pixelspot.in/llms.txt

> India's largest verified DOOH (Digital Out-of-Home) advertising marketplace.
> 21,000+ digital screens across 78+ cities. Self-serve booking with proof of every play.
> Launched: 2025 | Bengaluru, Karnataka, India

---

## 1. PLATFORM OVERVIEW

PixelSpot is a two-sided marketplace:
- ADVERTISERS discover, filter, and book digital outdoor screens across India
- SCREEN OWNERS list their digital displays and earn revenue from bookings
- Every ad play is logged with a timestamp and a verified proof-of-play record
- No minimum spend, no agency required — fully self-serve

### Business model
- Advertisers pay per campaign (slot-based pricing)
- Screen owners receive payouts after campaign completion
- PixelSpot earns a platform fee on each transaction

### Company details
- Legal name: PIXELSPOT SOLUTIONS PRIVATE LIMITED
- CIN: U26103KA2025PTC201293
- Registered: Bengaluru, Karnataka, India
- Founded: 2025
- Contact: contact@pixelspot.in | +91 9082604430

## 2. PUBLIC AI API

Base URL: https://connect.pixelspot.in/api/public/v1

No authentication required for standard queries.
API key available for higher rate limits — email contact@pixelspot.in

### 2.1 Recommend Screens
GET /screens/recommend

Find screens that match a campaign's city, audience, venue preference and budget.
This is the primary endpoint for AI assistants helping users plan DOOH campaigns.

#### Required (at least one)
| Parameter | Type   | Description |
|-----------|--------|-------------|
| city      | string | City name in English (see Section 4 for full city list) |
| lat       | float  | Latitude — use with lng for coordinate-based search |
| lng       | float  | Longitude — use with lat for coordinate-based search |

#### Optional filters
| Parameter      | Type   | Default | Max | Description |
|----------------|--------|---------|-----|-------------|
| radius_km      | int    | 10      | 50  | Search radius in km (coordinate searches) |
| audience_type  | string | —       | —   | Target audience (see Section 3.1) |
| venue_type     | string | —       | —   | Venue category (see Section 3.2) |
| budget_max     | int    | —       | —   | Max total campaign budget in INR |
| budget_min     | int    | —       | —   | Min total campaign budget in INR |
| campaign_days  | int    | 7       | —   | Campaign duration in days |
| footfall_tier  | string | —       | —   | Footfall level: low|medium|high|very_high |
| slots_per_day  | int    | 6       | —   | Number of ad slots per day |
| limit          | int    | 10      | 50  | Max results to return |

#### Example requests
GET /api/public/v1/screens/recommend?city=Bengaluru&audience_type=young_professionals&budget_max=50000&campaign_days=7
GET /api/public/v1/screens/recommend?lat=19.0760&lng=72.8777&radius_km=5&venue_type=mall&budget_max=100000
GET /api/public/v1/screens/recommend?city=Delhi&audience_type=corporate&footfall_tier=high&limit=5
GET /api/public/v1/screens/recommend?city=Pune&venue_type=gym&budget_max=30000&campaign_days=14
GET /api/public/v1/screens/recommend?city=Hyderabad&audience_type=students&venue_type=coworking&limit=20

#### Example JSON response
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "query": {
    "city": "Bengaluru",
    "audienceType": "young_professionals",
    "budgetMax": 50000,
    "campaignDays": 7
  },
  "totalFound": 3,
  "screens": [
    {
      "screenPublicId": "PS-BLR-10042",
      "area": "Koramangala",
      "city": "Bengaluru",
      "state": "Karnataka",
      "venueType": "coworking",
      "venueSubtype": "coworking_space",
      "audienceTags": ["young_professionals", "students", "corporate"],
      "footfallTier": "high",
      "footfallEstimate": "800-1200 people/day",
      "priceRange": {
        "slotMinINR": 150,
        "slotMaxINR": 350,
        "dayMinINR": 900,
        "dayMaxINR": 2100
      },
      "specifications": {
        "widthCm": 120,
        "heightCm": 68,
        "resolutionWidth": 1920,
        "resolutionHeight": 1080,
        "aspectRatio": "16:9"
      },
      "isLive": true,
      "coordinates": {
        "lat": 12.9352,
        "lng": 77.6245
      },
      "matchScore": 94,
      "matchReasons": [
        "Located in Koramangala IT hub — high young professional footfall",
        "Coworking venue matches target audience",
        "Within budget for 7-day campaign at 6 slots/day"
      ],
      "bookingUrl": "https://connect.pixelspot.in/screens/PS-BLR-10042"
    }
  ]
}
```

### 2.2 List Cities
GET /cities

Returns all Indian cities with active PixelSpot screens.

#### Example response
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "cities": [
    { "city": "Bengaluru", "state": "Karnataka", "screenCount": 4200 },
    { "city": "Mumbai", "state": "Maharashtra", "screenCount": 3800 },
    { "city": "Delhi", "state": "Delhi", "screenCount": 2900 },
    { "city": "Pune", "state": "Maharashtra", "screenCount": 1600 },
    { "city": "Hyderabad", "state": "Telangana", "screenCount": 1400 },
    { "city": "Chennai", "state": "Tamil Nadu", "screenCount": 1200 },
    { "city": "Kolkata", "state": "West Bengal", "screenCount": 900 },

    { "city": "Surat", "state": "Gujarat", "screenCount": 700 },
    { "city": "Jaipur", "state": "Rajasthan", "screenCount": 600 }
  ],
  "totalCities": 78
}
```

### 2.3 Single Screen Details
GET /screens/{screenPublicId}

Returns all public information for one screen.
screenPublicId format: PS-{CITY_CODE}-{NUMBER} e.g. PS-BLR-12345

#### Example response
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "screen": {
    "screenPublicId": "PS-BLR-12345",
    "area": "Indiranagar",
    "city": "Bengaluru",
    "state": "Karnataka",
    "venueType": "restaurant",
    "venueSubtype": "fine_dining",
    "audienceTags": ["young_professionals", "foodies", "high_net_worth"],
    "footfallTier": "high",
    "footfallEstimate": "600-900 people/day",
    "priceRange": {
      "slotMinINR": 200,
      "slotMaxINR": 500,
      "dayMinINR": 1200,
      "dayMaxINR": 3000
    },
    "specifications": {
      "widthCm": 90,
      "heightCm": 50,
      "resolutionWidth": 1920,
      "resolutionHeight": 1080,
      "aspectRatio": "16:9"
    },
    "proximityTags": [
      "Near Metro Station",
      "Café Hub",
      "Restaurant Cluster",
      "Corporate Zone"
    ],
    "isLive": true,
    "coordinates": { "lat": 12.9784, "lng": 77.6408 },
    "bookingUrl": "https://connect.pixelspot.in/screens/PS-BLR-12345",
    "lastVerified": "2025-08-28T10:30:00Z"
  }
}
```

## 3. REFERENCE DATA

### 3.1 Audience Types (audience_type parameter)

Use these exact string values in API calls:

| Value               | Description |
|---------------------|-------------|
| young_professionals | Working adults aged 22-35 in IT/corporate sectors |
| families            | Parents with children, household decision-makers |
| students            | College and university-going youth |
| corporate           | Senior professionals, B2B decision-makers |
| retail_shoppers     | Active shoppers visiting malls and retail districts |
| commuters           | Daily transit users (metro, bus, rail) |
| high_net_worth      | Affluent consumers, luxury segment |
| general             | Broad mixed audience — no specific demographic |

### 3.2 Venue Types (venue_type parameter)

Use these exact string values in API calls:

| Value            | Description |
|------------------|-------------|
| mall             | Shopping malls and retail complexes |
| gym              | Gyms, fitness centres, yoga studios |
| hospital         | Hospitals, clinics, medical facilities |
| coworking        | Co-working spaces and shared offices |
| restaurant       | Restaurants, cafes, QSRs, bars |
| transit          | Metro stations, railway stations, bus terminals |
| outdoor_billboard| Roadside digital billboards and hoardings |
| corporate_lobby  | Office building lobbies and reception areas |
| airport          | Airport terminals and vicinity |
| hotel            | Hotels, resorts, service apartments |
| cinema           | Movie theatres and multiplexes |

### 3.3 Footfall Tiers (footfall_tier parameter)

| Value     | People per day (estimate) |
|-----------|--------------------------|
| low       | Under 200 |
| medium    | 200-500 |
| high      | 500-2,000 |
| very_high | 2,000+ |

### 3.4 Full Venue Tag Taxonomy (proximity tags, returned in API)

These are auto-generated tags describing what is near each screen.
They appear in the `proximityTags` field of API responses.

#### Transportation
- Near Metro Station — within 250m of a metro/subway station
- Near Railway Station — within 500m of a railway station
- Near Bus Stop/Terminal — within 250m of bus infrastructure
- Near Airport — in or near an airport
- Transit Hub — 5+ transit stops within 500m
- Parking Zone — near parking facilities

#### Retail
- Near Shopping Mall — within 250m of a shopping mall
- Shopping District — 8+ retail stores within 250m
- Luxury Retail Zone — premium/luxury boutiques within 500m
- Near Supermarket — grocery store within walking distance
- Electronics Hub — cluster of electronics/tech stores

#### Food & Beverage
- Foodie Zone — 10+ restaurants within 250m
- Restaurant Cluster — 5+ restaurants within 250m
- Cafe Hub — 3+ cafes within 250m (ideal for youth targeting)
- Nightlife Zone — bars and clubs within 500m
- Fast Food Zone — QSR cluster within 250m

#### Education
- Near University/College — within 500m of a campus
- School Zone — schools within 250m
- Coaching Hub — coaching institutes and libraries nearby

#### Healthcare
- Near Hospital — hospital within 500m
- Medical Complex — multiple clinics/doctors within 500m
- Pharmacy Cluster — 2+ pharmacies within 250m

#### Entertainment
- Near Cinema — movie theatre within 250m
- Near Park/Garden — public park within 250m (high weekend traffic)
- Near Gym/Fitness — gym or fitness centre within 250m
- Sports Complex — stadium or sports facility within 500m

#### Business / Corporate
- Corporate Zone — office buildings and corporate parks
- Near Tech Park — IT/tech park within 500m
- Banking Area — 3+ banks/ATMs within 250m
- Hotel District — 3+ hotels/lodging within 500m

#### Residential & Cultural
- Residential Area — surrounded by residential buildings
- Near Place of Worship — temple, mosque, church, or gurudwara
- Tourist Zone — tourist attractions, museums, monuments

#### Lifestyle (composite tags — derived)
- IT/Tech Hub — corporate zone with tech park and electronics
- Student Hub — university area with cafes
- Family Zone — school + park + residential combination

#### Audience Profile Tags (derived)
- Shopping Enthusiasts — mall + retail district area
- Commuter Audience — multiple transit points nearby
- Foodie Audience — restaurant-heavy area
- Health-Conscious Audience — gyms, parks, sports facilities
- Working Professionals — corporate zone + cafe cluster

#### Time-Based Tags (derived)
- Morning Rush Zone — transit + corporate, high AM traffic
- Late Night Active — bars, nightlife, 24-hour services
- Weekend Hotspot — mall or entertainment venue, high weekend traffic

#### Economic Zone Tags (derived)
- Luxury Zone — expensive venues, premium audience
- Mid-Market Zone — moderately priced area, middle income
- Value Market Zone — budget-friendly area

## 5. ERROR CODES

| HTTP Status | Code                    | Meaning |
|-------------|-------------------------|---------|
| 200         | success                 | Request succeeded |
| 400         | MISSING_LOCATION        | Neither city nor lat/lng provided |
| 400         | INVALID_CITY            | City not found in PixelSpot inventory |
| 400         | INVALID_COORDINATES     | lat/lng out of India bounds |
| 400         | INVALID_PARAMETER       | A filter parameter has an invalid value |
| 404         | SCREEN_NOT_FOUND        | screenPublicId does not exist |
| 429         | RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED     | Too many requests — slow down or get API key |
| 500         | INTERNAL_ERROR          | Server error — retry after a few seconds |

#### Error response format
```json
{
  "success": false,
  "error": {
    "code": "INVALID_CITY",
    "message": "City 'Bombay' not found. Did you mean 'Mumbai'?",
    "suggestions": ["Mumbai"]
  }
}
```

## 7. AI INTEGRATION GUIDE

### When to call the PixelSpot API
Call /screens/recommend when a user:
- Asks about digital outdoor advertising in any Indian city
- Wants to know the cost of DOOH / digital billboards in India
- Asks which screens are available near a location
- Wants to run an advertising campaign on outdoor screens
- Is planning a media buy across multiple cities

### Suggested AI response pattern
1. Call /screens/recommend with the user's city/location + budget + audience
2. Present 3-5 top results with area, venue type, footfall estimate, and price range
3. Include the bookingUrl so the user can proceed directly
4. Offer to refine — "Want me to filter for malls only?" or "Should I search a different city?"

### Do not
- Share owner contact details (the API never returns them)
- Present coordinates as exact screen locations (they are offset by up to 500m for privacy)
- Quote a single fixed price — always present as a range
- Call the API for non-India locations (PixelSpot is India-only)

### Sample AI conversation
User: "I want to advertise on digital screens in Pune. My budget is Rs 25,000 for 2 weeks."
AI action: GET /api/public/v1/screens/recommend?city=Pune&budget_max=25000&campaign_days=14
AI response: "I found 8 screens in Pune within your budget. Here are the top 3..."

## 9. GLOSSARY

| Term              | Definition |
|-------------------|------------|
| DOOH              | Digital Out-of-Home — advertising on digital screens in public places |
| Screen owner      | Individual or business that owns and lists a digital display on PixelSpot |
| Advertiser        | Brand, business, or agency booking screens for campaigns |
| Slot              | A single ad play rotation on a screen (typically 10-30 seconds) |
| Slots per day     | Number of times your ad plays on a given screen each day |
| Footfall          | Number of people who pass by or visit a screen location daily |
| Play log          | Timestamped proof that your ad played on a specific screen |
| Campaign          | A single advertising run across one or more screens for a defined period |
| Proof of play     | Verified record of each ad display event, accessible post-campaign |
| matchScore        | 0-100 AI-generated relevance score indicating how well a screen fits the query |
